title: TypeScript tracker client writes bytes tk would not, and its fixture test is hand-picked
body: rfc3339 uses toISOString (.000Z vs tk's Z) and the test locks it in; encodeTick drops unknown fields; ready lacks tk's limit; next ignores manual/after; close ignores awaiting; claiming an epic is wave-gated; no activity entry. tracker-client.test.ts validates shapes for a hand-picked command list and never iterates manifest.commands, so 'proven against the pinned fixtures' is not yet true.
